Mars_7_negative: An afflicted Mars in the 7th is a severe Kuja Dosha. The spouse is violent or overly dominant, leading to aggressive physical or legal battles.
Saturn_11_positive: A strong Saturn brings massive, highly stable long-term wealth. You lead powerful, older, and highly influential social networks that fulfill all your goals.
Ketu_9_negative: An afflicted Ketu causes severe, chaotic rejection of all beliefs. You become completely aimless, wandering without purpose and alienating your spouse.
Sun_4_neutral: Sun in the 4th house of the Navamsha chart focuses your soul's purpose on establishing a secure, prominent, and respected domestic life.
Mercury_12_positive: A dignified Mercury gives brilliant behind-the-scenes planning. You excel in foreign lands, deep meditation, or highly creative isolated work.
Moon_8_negative: An afflicted Moon is extremely difficult, causing intense fear, paranoia, and emotional trauma. Hidden secrets severely damage the marriage.
Jupiter_3_negative: An afflicted Jupiter causes severe misjudgments in taking risks. You offer unsolicited, arrogant advice that alienates everyone around you.
Rahu_3_negative: An afflicted Rahu causes severe paranoia and highly manipulative communication. You constantly deceive your spouse, destroying all mutual trust.
Venus_2_positive: A well-placed Venus brings massive wealth, luxury, and highly aesthetic family assets. Your speech is incredibly sweet and charming.
